assertion_independence: No tautological input-to-itself guard found: budget/reason inputs are compared with actual stored/reconstructed outputs, so a lost or changed field fails; rendered_state uses a test renderer and proves node_budget propagation only, not production prompt rendering.

assertion_review.fails_if: Stored budget or optional reason is dropped/changed, or the independently fixed note is absent/wrong; reinstating the refusal also fails the acceptance assertions before this helper.
Queued-node reconstruction drops the note or reason; the note equality is anchored by line 33 to a fixed expected note, not two unconstrained values.
Dispatch returns nonzero or not-ok, or batch rejects/queues no request; the refusal mutation demonstrably fails these checks.
Over-fence validation refuses or fails to set a note, revalidation below the fence leaves the note stale, or malformed time becomes acceptable.
The picker budget changes from 240m or deterministic fallback stops choosing the available stub lane; single-candidate forced transport failure does not test comparative normal routing.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commits 25b85b5769e36fc28f65c7bba7d9efab777b4f89 and 668439bd8a007834d69da3ae088aac0d7f9522a4 against 7acce13077496a0942555e7eb59a68416d6ad14a; the first changes the shared validator, batch reason forwarding, CLI help and six test cases, and the second adds the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: Read live work-flows-to-the-lane section s63 and dispatch-detail.json (admit_request.node.done_when); baseline.log, final-head.log and negative-control.log demonstrate accepted dispatch and batch pointers, optional reasons, stable deterministic picker fallback and refusal sensitivity.
item_verdicts.goal: Read the source goal in dispatch-detail.json (admit_request.node.goal); reckon/crew/node.py:1517-1532 records budgets above the fence without a bounded refusal.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the source manifest.md and opened its baseline_suite and after_suite log paths; completed receipts show 51 baseline passes and 57 head passes with zero added failure IDs, and the refusal mutation records five failures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read dispatch-detail.json (admit_request.node.write_paths) and manifest.md orientation_write_paths; all five changed paths fall within the declared reckon, test and evidence scopes.

justifications.durability: tests/test_over_fence_budget_recorded_not_refused.py:30-37,81-123 fails on refused dispatch, dropped pointer fields, lost reconstruction, stale notes or accepted malformed durations, and negative-control.log confirms five failures when the refusal is reinstated.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_over_fence_budget_recorded_not_refused.py:81-105 reads stored pointers and the recorded red and green receipts substantiate acceptance, while lines 131-166 establish unchanged single-candidate fallback rather than a normal multi-candidate picker decision.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/node.py:803 adds a descriptive dataclass field and reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:642 extends the existing builder using its surrounding coercion idiom without forbidden source naming.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/node.py:1517-1532 replaces only the over-ceiling refusal with a recorded note, and reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:642 forwards the optional reason through the existing node builder.
justifications.reuse: Capability searches for budget validation, pointer reconstruction and fixture configuration resolve to reckon/crew/node.py:1337, reckon/crew/admission/launching.py:71 and tests/test_every_path_meets_the_node_contract.py:102, which the change extends or reuses without adding a parallel production mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: The five paths in the two-commit diff are all covered by dispatch-detail.json admit_request.node.write_paths, including the independently assigned evidence fragment.

limitations: Picker parity is deterministic single-candidate fallback, explicitly disclosed in the evidence fragment; no live provider or multi-candidate decision is measured.
Failure delta covers the source declared gate only, not a full suite or merged head.
